worldfold.limit: Network limit reached (24 per owner, 128 per world).
worldfold.overlap: That aperture overlaps an existing fold.
worldfold.blocked: Anchor must be installed and its entire aperture must be clear.
worldfold.owner: Only the fold owner can change this.
worldfold.already_branch: This fold already has an alternate route.
worldfold.buffer: Resources in transit. Restore the receiver and let the buffer drain first.
worldfold.occupied: Move creatures and items away from the aperture before removing it.
worldfold.failure: Spatial operation failed. See server log.
worldfold.removed: Fold dismantled. Anchors can now be broken.
worldfold.protected: Dismantle this fold with the Spatial Tuner before mining its anchor.
worldfold.recall_only: Emergency recall is only available inside Foldspace.
worldfold.anchor_selected: A selected (%s × %s). Click a second anchor to create the fold.
worldfold.compass_help: Use on two Seam Anchors. Air-use: aperture / clear selection.
worldfold.compass_help2: Sneak air-use: exit scale. Sneak-use on anchor: cancel.
worldfold.branch_source: Select anchor A to add a branch.
worldfold.branch_pending: Select an unused Seam Anchor for destination C.
worldfold.branch_added: Branch installed. Signal 8+ behind A selects C.
worldfold.confirm_remove: Sneak-use on an anchor to confirm dismantling.
worldfold.tuner_help: Air-use cycles mode. Use on a Seam Anchor. Sneak air-use clears branch selection.
worldfold.no_nested_seed: Create new chambers from outside Foldspace; links inside are allowed.
worldfold.room_created: Chamber created: %s × %s. Walk through the seam.
worldfold.seed_help: Air-use chooses room size. Use on an unused anchor to create the chamber.
